plain: Jay Anderson, a guest on a podcast about secret elites and aliens, points to the temple at Dendera in Egypt, where he says a carving shows what looks like the classic light bulb. He offers it as a sign that ancient people may have had knowledge or technology far beyond what history credits them with.
